description: This Java class 'TestUtil' provides utility methods for testing within the OpenMRS project. It includes functions for assertions, file and property handling, output formatting, database table printing, global property management, collection searching, timing delays, and date creation, all tailored for testing purposes in OpenMRS.

classes.name: TestUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing various static methods to facilitate testing in the OpenMRS framework.

methods.name: assertCollectionContentsEquals
methods.description: Asserts that two collections have the same contents, regardless of order.

methods.name: getRuntimeProperties
methods.description: Mimics the retrieval of runtime properties, checking environment variables and property files.

methods.name: printAssignableToSingleString
methods.description: Outputs a string with escape characters for newlines and quotes, suitable for assigning to a single string variable.

methods.name: printStringBuilderOutput
methods.description: Formats multi-line output into StringBuilder append statements.

methods.name: printOutTableContents
methods.description: Prints the contents of specified database tables using a given SQL connection.

methods.name: saveGlobalProperty
methods.description: Creates or updates a global property with a specified name and value.

methods.name: containsId
methods.description: Checks if a collection of BaseOpenmrsObjects contains an object with the specified ID.

methods.name: waitForClockTick
methods.description: Pauses execution until the system clock advances to the next second.

methods.name: createDateTime
methods.description: Creates a Date object from a string in 'yyyy-MM-dd hh:mm:ss' format.
